id: 19_Fundamentals of Working Safely with Formaldehyde and Glutaraldehyde Introduction
title: 甲醛和戊二醛的安全使用（国内版）
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/19_Fundamentals of Working Safely with Formaldehyde and Glutaraldehyde Introduction.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/19_Fundamentals of Working Safely with Formaldehyde and Glutaraldehyde Introduction（国内版）/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在通风柜旁，柜里放着两只空白标签的试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a chemical fume hood with two reagent bottles with blank labels inside, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲甲醛和戊二醛的安全使用。
overlay: 甲醛和戊二醛的安全使用

shots.scene: 鼻子、肺、盾牌、通风柜四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a nose, a pair of lungs, a shield, and a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 认清危害，做好防护，规范处置。

shots.scene: 阿杰在普通实验台上拧开一瓶固定液，皱眉捂鼻
shots.prompt_en: The young male student unscrews a reagent bottle with a blank label at an open lab bench and wrinkles his nose, covering it with his hand.
shots.narration: 阿杰在敞开的台面上开了一瓶固定液。

shots.scene: 阿杰揉眼睛、咳嗽，身边飘着淡淡的气味线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rubs his eyes and coughs; faint wavy vapor lines drift around him.
shots.narration: 刺鼻的气味，让他眼睛发酸、直咳嗽。

shots.scene: 小研拉他离开台面，指向通风柜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leads the young male student away from the bench and points at the chemical fume hood.
shots.narration: 小研赶紧让他盖好瓶子，换到通风柜。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 这刺鼻的气味，就是危害在提醒你。

shots.scene: 两只空白标签试剂瓶，旁边是骷髅和健康危害象形图
shots.prompt_en: Two reagent bottles with blank labels next to a skull pictogram and a health hazard pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 甲醛和戊二醛，都是有毒的化合物。

shots.scene: 组织固定、器械消毒两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a tissue sample cassette in a jar and a medical instrument soaking in a tray. No people.
shots.narration: 常用来固定标本、消毒器械。

shots.scene: 人体呼吸道示意，鼻腔到肺部发红
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of the human airway from nose to lungs, glowing red along the way. No people.
shots.narration: 吸入它们的蒸气，会刺激呼吸道。

shots.scene: 喉咙、气喘、支气管三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a sore throat, a wheezing person pictogram with an inhaler, and inflamed bronchial tubes. No people.
shots.narration: 可能引起喉炎、哮喘、支气管炎。

shots.scene: 肺部图标上出现裂纹和向下箭头
shots.prompt_en: A lung icon with small cracks and a downward arrow beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 严重时，呼吸功能也会受损。

shots.scene: 欣欣表情严肃，举起健康危害标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a health hazard pictogram with a serious face.
shots.narration: 甲醛还有一个更大的危害。

shots.scene: 人形图标胸前的健康危害象形图
shots.prompt_en: A person silhouette icon with a health hazard pictogram on its chest. No people.
shots.narration: 长期接触甲醛，可能导致癌症。

shots.scene: 一本空白的标准文本和天平图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank standard document with a scales of justice icon on its cover. No people.
shots.narration: 正因如此，职业接触有专门的标准。

shots.scene: 空气中的分子点被一条上限线压住
shots.prompt_en: Small molecule dots floating in air, kept below a horizontal limit line. No people.
shots.narration: 目的是把工作中的接触降到最低。

shots.scene: 王老师指着空白的法规文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank binder of regulations on a shelf.
shots.narration: 我国也有职业病防治的法律和标准。

shots.scene: 小研翻开空白的标准操作规程
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank standard operating procedure binder at her desk.
shots.narration: 用这两种醛，天天按规程和标准做。

shots.scene: 小研举起一份空白的安全技术说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up a blank safety data sheet with hazard pictograms on the first page.
shots.narration: 厂家的安全技术说明书，要先看。

shots.scene: 说明书旁三个图标：危险特性、鼻子和手、器官
shots.prompt_en: A blank safety data sheet next to three icons: a hazard diamond, a nose and a hand for exposure routes, and a body organ. No people.
shots.narration: 危害特性、暴露途径、健康影响都在里面。

shots.scene: 老周和小研对着空白风险评估表讨论
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student review a blank risk assessment form at a desk.
shots.narration: 实验前，按风险管理计划评估风险。

shots.scene: 用量、时长、场所三个图标连到一个盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a bottle, a clock and a room, connected by lines to a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用多少、做多久、在哪做，决定怎么防。

shots.scene: 通风柜、手套、护目镜三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a chemical fume hood, gloves and safety goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 防护措施，就是不让它接触到你。

shots.scene: 蒸气被挡在盾牌外
shots.prompt_en: Wavy vapor lines bounce off a shield placed in front of a person silhouette. No people.
shots.narration: 不吸入、不沾皮肤、不溅进眼睛。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着墙上空白的应急流程图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a blank emergency flowchart poster on the lab wall.
shots.narration: 万一出了事，按实验室的程序处置。

shots.scene: 阿杰在应急流程图前认真看
shots.prompt_en: The young male student studies the blank emergency flowchart poster on the wall.
shots.narration: 应急程序，平时就要熟悉。

shots.scene: 王老师在培训室给学生讲解
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a small group of students in a training room in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 参加培训，学会安全操作。

shots.scene: 阿杰敲门进老周办公室说明情况
shots.prompt_en: The young male student knocks and enters the older man's office to report something.
shots.narration: 有担心、有隐患，及时向负责人报告。

shots.scene: 试剂瓶空白标签上的健康危害和感叹号象形图
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle whose blank label shows a health hazard pictogram and an exclamation mark pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 每个盛装容器都要有清楚的标签。

shots.scene: 实验室门口的当心中毒警示标志和空白告知卡
shots.prompt_en: A toxic hazard warning sign beside a lab door, with a blank notice card under it. No people.
shots.narration: 工作场所要设警示标识和告知卡。

shots.scene: 老周向新来的阿杰讲解告知卡
shots.prompt_en: The older man explains the blank notice card at the lab door to the young male student.
shots.narration: 负责人要如实告知危害和防护办法。

shots.scene: 小研在通风柜里倒取溶液，柜门拉低
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a lab coat, goggles and gloves, pours a solution inside a chemical fume hood with the sash pulled low.
shots.narration: 开瓶、量取、配制，都在通风柜里做。

shots.scene: 敞口台面上冒蒸气的瓶子被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an open bottle releasing vapor on an open bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不在敞开的台面上开瓶倒液。

shots.scene: 小研随手盖紧瓶盖，台面铺着吸水垫
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student caps the bottle tightly; an absorbent pad lies on the work surface.
shots.narration: 用完随手盖紧，台面铺好吸水垫。

shots.scene: 几副不同材质的手套，旁边是空白的说明书
shots.prompt_en: Several pairs of gloves of different materials next to a blank safety data sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 手套材质，按SDS和耐渗透资料选。

shots.scene: 手套破损和发软的图标，旁边是更换箭头
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a torn glove and a swollen glove, with a circular arrow pointing to a fresh pair. No people.
shots.narration: 发现破损、沾染，立即更换。

shots.scene: 小研戴好护目镜和面屏
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on safety goggles and a face shield over her lab coat.
shots.narration: 可能溅出时，加戴护目镜和面屏。

shots.scene: 带空白危险废物标签的废液桶，放在托盘里
shots.prompt_en: A closed waste liquid container with a blank hazardous waste label, standing in a spill tray. No people.
shots.narration: 用过的醛类溶液，倒进专用废液桶。

shots.scene: 往水槽里倒液体的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of liquid being poured down a sink drain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不倒进水槽和下水道。

shots.scene: 小研盖紧废液桶，在空白记录单上登记
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the waste container lid and writes on a blank waste log sheet.
shots.narration: 盖紧、登记，交学校按危险废物处置。

shots.scene: 台面上小片溅洒，旁边是吸附垫和警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A small liquid spill on a bench next to absorbent pads and a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 少量溅洒，戴好防护用吸附材料处理。

shots.scene: 阿杰在水槽边用流水冲洗手臂
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rinses his forearm under running water at a lab sink.
shots.narration: 沾到皮肤，脱去污染衣物，流水冲洗。

shots.scene: 洗眼器标志和洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash sign above a lab eyewash station with water flowing. No people.
shots.narration: 溅进眼睛，立即到洗眼器冲洗。

shots.scene: 小研扶阿杰到走廊通风处，老周赶来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student helps the young male student out to a well-ventilated corridor while the older man hurries over.
shots.narration: 吸入不适，马上到空气新鲜处。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁有红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 报告负责人，需要时就医，急救120。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现肺部和健康危害图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of lungs and a health hazard pictogram.
shots.narration: 两种醛伤呼吸道，甲醛还能致癌。

shots.scene: 规程、SDS、风险评估表三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank procedure binder, a blank safety data sheet and a blank risk assessment form. No people.
shots.narration: 读规程、看SDS、做评估。

shots.scene: 通风柜、手套、废液桶三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a fume hood, gloves and a closed waste container. No people.
shots.narration: 柜内操作，选对手套，废液进桶。

shots.scene: 欣欣在通风柜旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera beside a tidy chemical fume hood with its sash closed.
shots.narration: 管好两种醛，安全每一天，下次见！
